text:
sophia: quick ask — can someone run a targeted throughput run for cb with late-arrival preemption enabled? want to reproduce the small-batch fallback behavior we saw in canary.

mike: which config? max_batch_size=256? queue_window_ms=8?

sophia: trying to test 3 axes: max_batch_size= [64,128,256], queue_window_ms=[4,8,16], and preemption_enabled=true/false. focus on seq_len=512 workload. target 10k requests over 5m.

anna: fyi loadgen job name: `cb-preempt-2003-512`. i'll provision a single-gpu staging shard. please post exact command.

raj: run this (from infra):
```
loadgen --job cb-preempt-2003-512 --arrival-mode poisson --lambda 120 --duration 300 --seq-len 512 --concurrency 16 --model redwood-v1-q4f16 --max-batch 128 --queue-ms 8
```

mike: also add `--late-arrival-preempt=true` flag to emulate real request churn.

deploy-bot: scheduled job `cb-preempt-2003-512` on shard-staging-7 at 2003456905. logs -> https://internal.logs/job/cb-preempt-2003-512

lina: quick note — earlier canary with preemption saw increased token drop events around 95s mark. p99 jumped ~40% when queue overflowed.

sophia: thanks — can you grab p99, tokens/s, batch_size distribution, and drop_rate? a short CSV or a screenshot is fine.

lina: attaching quick summary (copied):
- max_batch=128, queue_ms=8, preempt=true => p50 42ms, p95 180ms, p99 420ms, drop_rate 0.8%
- max_batch=256, queue_ms=8, preempt=true => p50 45ms, p95 240ms, p99 760ms, drop_rate 2.1%
- max_batch=64, queue_ms=4, preempt=false => p50 38ms, p95 160ms, p99 360ms, drop_rate 0.2%

raj: looks like larger batches hurt tail when preemption is on — maybe preemption cancels bigger batches mid-compile/dispatch causing requeue thrash.

mike: theory: KV cache warmup interacts badly — large batch triggers cache churn when preempted. try `cache_lock_timeout=50ms` and smaller backlog cap.

sophia: can we do a quick follow-up smoke: max_batch=128, queue_ms=8, preempt=true + cache_lock_timeout=50ms? mike/anna can you run?

anna: scheduling now. i'll ping when finished.

mike: running it. i'll monitor `queue.full` and `preempt.cancel` counters in the console.

sophia: brilliant. if this reduces drop_rate below 0.5% and p99 < 500ms we can recommend default preemption on for seq_len<=512 with cache_lock_timeout=50ms.

lina: test finished — early numbers look promising: p99 380ms, drop_rate 0.3%, batch_size median 96. will add full csv to the ticket.

sophia: awesome, thanks team. next steps: anna to add test harness to nightly, mike to open PR for `cache_lock_timeout` default, lina to attach perf artifacts to the run. :thumbsup:
